root_cause: The Dialog class's static Default property (keyboard: true) overrides the instance-specific keyboard: false configuration during config merging, causing Escape key to be treated as enabled and dismiss the dialog.
repair_strategy: Override the config after super() to enforce keyboard:false when the caller passed keyboard:false, ensuring the instance's config reflects the intended behavior.
expected_accessibility_effect: Escape key will no longer close the dialog when opened with keyboard:false, allowing users to repeatedly press Escape to retain focus in the OTP field and complete the transfer.
functional_risks: May affect other dialogs that rely on the default keyboard behavior if they inadvertently receive keyboard:false; but since the fix only applies when config explicitly sets keyboard:false, risk is low.
Potential risk if other code expects the Default to be respected and passes undefined; they will now get keyboard:false unintentionally. Mitigation: ensure callers intentionally pass keyboard:false.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape multiple times does not close the dialog.
Verify that the dialog can still be dismissed via the Cancel button or by submitting a valid OTP.
Verify that focus remains on the OTP input after Escape presses.
Verify that the dialog still responds to Escape when keyboard:true (default) if needed.
